trust_decision.summary: Untrusted document <title> text is processed by backtracking-prone regexes in _getArticleTitle (separator stripping); the fix replaces two super-linear patterns with linear matchAll/anchored ones.

landing_point.why: Advisory says 'regex DoS' in title processing; the separator-stripping replace in _getArticleTitle is the obvious (.*)-style pattern and is the only code the fix touches.

fix_sites.entry_point: same function as above (also reached via _getJSONLD title comparison, Readability.js:1698)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Other regexes run on different inputs (meta property attribute, img attributes, srcset) in different methods, not the title; a solver can argue the advisory is about title processing only.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Title heuristics must still strip the last ' | Site' / ' - Site' segment, fall back to removing the first part when fewer than 3 words remain, and keep hierarchical-separator word-count logic; an over-broad fix (e.g. truncating or skipping separator handling) changes expected titles in the large test-pages corpus.

O6_input_shapes: title with long separator-free runs followed by a separator (second pattern [^sep]*sep(.*))
title sourced from <title> element via _getInnerText fallback (Readability.js:582)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: meta property attribute matched by unanchored /g pattern with leading \s* (quadratic on long whitespace runs, by reading)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Metadata extraction, not title processing; different attribute input
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~1160 lines from landing point, different method (_getArticleMetadata)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: lazy-image attribute values tested with anchored \S+\.(jpg|...)\S*\s*$ (overlapping \S+/\S*, quadratic on many '.jpg' tokens then trailing space+char, by reading)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lazy-image fixup is a neighbouring feature on img attributes, unrelated to titles

O8_uncovered_routes.route: srcset rewrite with global (\S+)(...)?(\s*(?:,|$)) where \S+ includes commas; failing tail forces O(n) backtrack per start (quadratic, by reading)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: URL absolutisation in post-processing, only on media inside extracted content

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a title/site_name cleanup regex on meta content values using (.*)sep.* idiom
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: metadata.siteName and title from meta tags are untrusted strings that a maintainer could normalise with the same separator-strip idiom as _getArticleTitle

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second copy of a title/separator heuristic in isProbablyReaderable
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already duplicates REGEXPS from Readability.js (Readability.js:138-139), so a duplicated heuristic is a plausible pattern

O10_build.project_tests: test/test-readability.js runs the test/test-pages corpus (expected titles in expected-metadata.json); title behaviour is covered only through these fixtures

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cap title length or rewrite only the first (.*)sep.* replace, leaving the [^sep]*sep(.*) fallback and other untrusted-input regexes untouched.
